description: National Risk Index Annualized Frequency Heat Wave is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by FEMA AGOL. National Risk Index Version: March 2023 (1.19.0) A Heat Wave is a period of abnormally and uncomfortably hot and unusually humid weather typically lasting two or more days with temperatures outside the historical averages for a given area. Annualized frequency values for Heat Waves are in units of event-days per year. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of FEMA AGOL.
